title: Anytime-Valid PAC-Bayes Certificates for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.21241v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time scaling systems often choose how much to sample, which prompt to use, and which verifier or aggregation rule to trust after repeatedly inspecting a calibration set. Standard validation error bars are not valid after this adaptive selection. We model a test-time scaling recipe as a randomized predictor with a random cost and prove a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that holds simultaneously over all calibration times, all posterior mixtures over recipes, and all data-dependent stopping rules. Thus the same event covers the recipe search that precedes deployment, not merely the fixed recipe finally reported. For a finite grid of budgets and verifiers, the penalty is the familiar $\log M/n$, which in the worst case no certificate valid after selection can avoid, while non-uniform priors and localized posterior mixtures can give sharper certificates for structured searches. translated_title: 自适应测试时扩展的任意时刻有效PAC-Bayes证书
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展系统通常在反复检查校准集之后，才决定采样多少、使用哪个提示词，以及信任哪个验证器或聚合规则。在这种自适应选择之后，标准的验证误差界便不再有效。我们将测试时扩展方案建模为具有随机成本的随机化预测器，并证明了一个时间一致的PAC-Bayes证书，该证书同时对所有校准时刻、所有关于方案的后验混合分布，以及所有依赖数据的停止规则成立。因此，同一事件既覆盖了部署之前进行的方案搜索，也覆盖了最终报告的固定方案。对于预算和验证器的有限网格，惩罚项是熟悉的 $\log M/n$，在最坏情况下，任何在选择之后有效的证书都无法避免该惩罚项；而非均匀先验和局部化的后验混合分布可以为结构化搜索提供更紧的证书。我们将该结果专门化到自洽性方法并展示
tldr: 本文证明了适用于自适应选择的任意时刻有效PAC-Bayes证书，使测试时扩展系统在自适应确定采样量、提示词和验证器之后仍能获得统计有效的泛化保证，且同一保证覆盖部署前的全部方案搜索过程。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that remains statistically valid after adaptive selection of sampling budgets, prompts, and verifiers, covering the entire recipe search process prior to deployment.
